correctness.rationale: The conditional Markov backward system and bounded eigenvalue produce the exact Laplace transform. A Laplace-distributed rate difference yields the defective mass. Gaussian-tail mixing and controlled small/large difference regions yield an O(s) remainder after the sharp s log singularity. IID renewed episodes give the exact restart mean, and dominated convergence gives the high-reset prefactor. The independent integral numerical checker passes 39 parameter checks. Scope and limits are explicit.

value.rationale: For the existing heavy-tail persistent-search model, a physical first-passage question explicitly motivated in the source receives a rigorous answer. Equal mean reversal intensities do not guarantee hitting, and a sharp logarithmic singularity and competing inverse/exponential reset costs produce a nontrivial resetting benefit and interior optimum. This is a structural transport distinction, not a numerical or parameter-slice exercise.
